snippet.title: PROJECT MIX - Official February Teaser
snippet.description:
PROJECT MIX is a VR anime cyberpunk bartending adventure developed by PLECTRUM SOFT. What will you do when you've lost everything you once had?

If it looks interesting please check out our socials and give our game a wishlist, it would mean the world!

Back Us On Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/plectrumsoft/project-mix-upcoming-vr-indie-title-inspired-by-90s-anime
Steam Store Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2439770/Project_Mix
Twitter: https://twitter.com/plectrumxr
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/gaming/plectrumxr
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/plectrumxr/
Discord: https://discord.gg/projectmix
